environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS CloudFront distribution as CDN layer. CloudFront is configured with a custom response headers policy (ID: managed-policy-67f8-4d2c) that injects Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self' on ALL responses from the origin. Additionally, the ECS task role has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoExternalNetworkBoundary) that restricts the task's outbound network via VPC endpoints only (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route in the private subnet route table). Session credentials use a custom token rotation mechanism where the Apollo context validator cross-references a DynamoDB TTL-based session table with a rotation interval of 60 seconds — tokens older than 60s are rejected at the context layer regardless of the sessionsStore in-memory state. The CloudFront distribution also has a Lambda@Edge viewer-response function that strips any response body content matching /<script[^>]*>/gi patterns as a defense-in-depth measure.

config.cdn: CloudFront with custom response headers policy
config.lambda_edge: viewer-response function strips <script> tags from response body
config.network: private subnet, no IGW/NAT, VPC endpoints only
